#### fresh generation
# github-build --organization test-org --skip_repository_settings --skip_gitignore --skip_slack --skip_license_check
---
name: Build
'on':
  pull_request:
    types:
    - opened
    - edited
    - reopened
    - synchronize
  push:
    branches:
    - master
    - "[0-9]*"
    - dependabot/**
    tags:
    - "**"
permissions:
  contents: read
env:
  NODE-CACHE: yarn
  NODE-VERSION: <node-version>
concurrency:
  group: build-${{github.ref}}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  variables:
    name: Prepare Variables
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      BUILD_NAME: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_NAME}}"
      BUILD_VERSION: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_VERSION}}"
      COMMIT_MESSAGE: "${{steps.variables.outputs.COMMIT_MESSAGE}}"
      MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: "${{steps.variables.outputs.MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_BETA: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_RC: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_PROD: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD}}"
      DEPLOY_MACOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_MACOS}}"
      DEPLOY_TVOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_TVOS}}"
      DEPLOY_OPTIONS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_OPTIONS}}"
      SKIP_LICENSES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LICENSES}}"
      SKIP_LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS}}"
      SKIP_TESTS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS}}"
      UPDATE_PACKAGES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.UPDATE_PACKAGES}}"
      LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Prepare variables
      id: variables
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/variables@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  eslint:
    name: JavaScript ES Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: ESLint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/eslint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
  semgrep:
    name: Semgrep Security Scanner
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Semgrep
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/semgrep@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  trivy:
    name: Container & IaC Vulnerability Scanner
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Trivy
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/trivy@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  yamllint:
    name: YAML Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Yamllint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/yamllint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
  js_unit_tests:
    name: JavaScript Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS != '1'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        node-version: "${{env.NODE-VERSION}}"
        node-cache: "${{env.NODE-CACHE}}"
        node-cache-dependency-path: yarn.lock
    - name: Yarn
      shell: bash
      run: yarn install
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{github.token}}"
    - name: Jest
      shell: bash
      run: npx jest
  beta_deploy:
    name: Beta Deploy
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    - eslint
    - semgrep
    - trivy
    - yamllint
    - js_unit_tests
    if: "${{always() && needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA == '1' && needs.variables.result != 'failure' && needs.eslint.result != 'failure' && needs.semgrep.result != 'failure' && needs.trivy.result != 'failure' && needs.yamllint.result != 'failure' && needs.js_unit_tests.result != 'failure'}}"
    env:
      VERCEL_ORG_ID: "${{secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID}}"
      VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: "${{secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID}}"
      VERCEL_TOKEN: "${{secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN}}"
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        aws-access-key-id: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || ''}}"
        aws-secret-access-key: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || ''}}"
        aws-region: "${{secrets.AWS_DEFAULT_REGION}}"
        aws-role-to-assume: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME}}"
    - name: Install Vercel CLI
      run: npm install --global vercel@latest
    - name: Pull Vercel Environment Information
      run: vercel pull --yes --environment=preview
    - name: Deploy Project to Vercel
      id: deploy
      run: echo "url=$(vercel deploy)" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
  rc_deploy:
    name: RC Deploy
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    - eslint
    - semgrep
    - trivy
    - yamllint
    - js_unit_tests
    if: "${{always() && needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC == '1' && needs.variables.result != 'failure' && needs.eslint.result != 'failure' && needs.semgrep.result != 'failure' && needs.trivy.result != 'failure' && needs.yamllint.result != 'failure' && needs.js_unit_tests.result != 'failure'}}"
    env:
      VERCEL_ORG_ID: "${{secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID}}"
      VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: "${{secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID}}"
      VERCEL_TOKEN: "${{secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN}}"
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        aws-access-key-id: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || ''}}"
        aws-secret-access-key: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || ''}}"
        aws-region: "${{secrets.AWS_DEFAULT_REGION}}"
        aws-role-to-assume: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME}}"
    - name: Install Vercel CLI
      run: npm install --global vercel@latest
    - name: Pull Vercel Environment Information
      run: vercel pull --yes --environment=preview
    - name: Deploy Project to Vercel
      id: deploy
      run: echo "url=$(vercel deploy)" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
  prod_deploy:
    name: Prod Deploy
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    - eslint
    - semgrep
    - trivy
    - yamllint
    - js_unit_tests
    if: "${{always() && needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD == '1' && needs.variables.result != 'failure' && needs.eslint.result != 'failure' && needs.semgrep.result != 'failure' && needs.trivy.result != 'failure' && needs.yamllint.result != 'failure' && needs.js_unit_tests.result != 'failure'}}"
    env:
      VERCEL_ORG_ID: "${{secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID}}"
      VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: "${{secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID}}"
      VERCEL_TOKEN: "${{secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN}}"
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        aws-access-key-id: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || ''}}"
        aws-secret-access-key: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || ''}}"
        aws-region: "${{secrets.AWS_DEFAULT_REGION}}"

#### regeneration over a customized build.yml
# github-build --organization test-org --skip_repository_settings --skip_gitignore --skip_slack --skip_license_check
---
name: Build
'on':
  pull_request:
    types:
    - opened
    - edited
    - reopened
    - synchronize
  push:
    branches:
    - master
    - "[0-9]*"
    - dependabot/**
    tags:
    - "**"
permissions:
  contents: read
env:
  CUSTOM_WORKFLOW_ENV: kept
  NODE-CACHE: yarn
  NODE-VERSION: <node-version>
concurrency:
  group: build-${{github.ref}}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  variables:
    name: Prepare Variables
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      BUILD_NAME: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_NAME}}"
      BUILD_VERSION: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_VERSION}}"
      COMMIT_MESSAGE: "${{steps.variables.outputs.COMMIT_MESSAGE}}"
      MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: "${{steps.variables.outputs.MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_BETA: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_RC: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_PROD: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD}}"
      DEPLOY_MACOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_MACOS}}"
      DEPLOY_TVOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_TVOS}}"
      DEPLOY_OPTIONS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_OPTIONS}}"
      SKIP_LICENSES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LICENSES}}"
      SKIP_LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS}}"
      SKIP_TESTS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS}}"
      UPDATE_PACKAGES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.UPDATE_PACKAGES}}"
      LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Prepare variables
      id: variables
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/variables@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  actionlint:
    name: Github Actions Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Actionlint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/actionlint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
  eslint:
    name: JavaScript ES Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: ESLint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/eslint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  semgrep:
    name: Semgrep Security Scanner
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:

        aws-secret-access-key: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || ''}}"

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      BUILD_NAME: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_NAME}}"
      BUILD_VERSION: "${{steps.variables.outputs.BUILD_VERSION}}"
      COMMIT_MESSAGE: "${{steps.variables.outputs.COMMIT_MESSAGE}}"
      MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: "${{steps.variables.outputs.MODIFIED_GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_BETA: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_RC: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_RC}}"
      DEPLOY_ON_PROD: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_PROD}}"
      DEPLOY_MACOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_MACOS}}"
      DEPLOY_TVOS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_TVOS}}"
      DEPLOY_OPTIONS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_OPTIONS}}"
      SKIP_LICENSES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LICENSES}}"
      SKIP_LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS}}"
      SKIP_TESTS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS}}"
      UPDATE_PACKAGES: "${{steps.variables.outputs.UPDATE_PACKAGES}}"
      LINTERS: "${{steps.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Prepare variables
      id: variables
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/variables@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
  actionlint:
    name: Github Actions Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - name: Actionlint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/actionlint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
  eslint:
    name: JavaScript ES Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: ESLint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/eslint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  semgrep:
    name: Semgrep Security Scanner
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Semgrep
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/semgrep@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  trivy:
    name: Container & IaC Vulnerability Scanner
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Trivy
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/trivy@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  yamllint:
    name: YAML Linter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_LINTERS != '1' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Yamllint
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/linters/yamllint@v3
      with:
        linters: "${{needs.variables.outputs.LINTERS}}"
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        reviewdog-token: "${{github.token}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  js_unit_tests:
    name: JavaScript Unit Tests
    runs-on: custom-runner
    needs:
    - variables
    if: "${{needs.variables.outputs.SKIP_TESTS != '1'}}"
    env:
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        node-version: "${{env.NODE-VERSION}}"
        node-cache: "${{env.NODE-CACHE}}"
        node-cache-dependency-path: yarn.lock
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Yarn
      shell: bash
      run: yarn install --customized
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{github.token}}"
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Jest
      shell: bash
      run: npx jest --customized
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
  beta_deploy:
    name: Beta Deploy
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - variables
    - actionlint
    - eslint
    - semgrep
    - trivy
    - yamllint
    - js_unit_tests
    if: "${{always() && needs.variables.outputs.DEPLOY_ON_BETA == '1' && needs.variables.result != 'failure' && needs.actionlint.result != 'failure' && needs.eslint.result != 'failure' && needs.semgrep.result != 'failure' && needs.trivy.result != 'failure' && needs.yamllint.result != 'failure' && needs.js_unit_tests.result != 'failure'}}"
    env:
      VERCEL_ORG_ID: "${{secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID}}"
      VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: "${{secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID}}"
      CUSTOM_JOB_ENV: kept
      VERCEL_TOKEN: "${{secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN}}"
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
    - name: Setup
      uses: cloud-officer/ci-actions/setup@v3
      with:
        ssh-key: "${{secrets.SSH_KEY}}"
        github-token: "${{github.token}}"
        aws-access-key-id: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || ''}}"
        aws-secret-access-key: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME == '' && secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || ''}}"
        aws-region: "${{secrets.AWS_DEFAULT_REGION}}"
        aws-role-to-assume: "${{vars.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME}}"
        custom-input: kept
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Install Vercel CLI
      run: npm install --global vercel@latest --customized
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Pull Vercel Environment Information
      run: vercel pull --yes --environment=preview
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Deploy Project to Vercel
      id: deploy
      run: echo "url=$(vercel deploy)" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      env:
        CUSTOM_STEP_ENV: kept
    - name: Custom Step
      run: echo custom
